calls.title: A24 + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the usage and licensing status of the A24 Films GrowthBook account, confirming they are on a 3-seat Starter plan with one project. Participants discussed the limitations of the Starter plan and the potential benefits of upgrading to the Pro tier for enhanced features, including governance and security options available at the Enterprise level. A24 Films is experiencing internal growth through A24 Labs, necessitating a transition from boutique to enterprise tools. The conversation also emphasized GrowthBook's strengths, such as lightweight SDKs and powerful experimentation capabilities, which align with A24's needs for a robust governance structure. Next steps included a recommended upgrade to the Pro tier and a follow-up meeting to reassess future Enterprise requirements within a quarter or two.
calls.keywords: feature flags, GrowthBook, Pro tier, Enterprise tier, experimentation, A24 Labs
